# CameraTexture

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CameraTexture")`

Draws what a camera sees into a texture. The picture is available as `view://` followed by `ViewName`, and anything that takes a texture can show it: an `ImageLabel` on a `SurfaceGui`, a `Decal` or a material's map. For a wall of security monitors, use one per camera.

The number of views drawn per frame is limited by `[render] max_views_per_frame` in the project settings (4 by default). The view with the oldest picture is drawn first, so twelve monitors take turns. Views are drawn before the main view and show the current frame; a camera that sees its own texture sees the previous frame's picture.

It is visual only: the simulation does not see it, and a dedicated server draws nothing. It is not replicated. In a multiplayer match, create the cameras and their textures in a client script on the machine that shows them.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Camera` | `Camera?` | — | read/write | The camera to draw from. With nil, nothing is drawn and the texture keeps its last picture. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the view is drawn. A disabled view keeps its last picture and costs nothing. |
| `Quality` | `Enum.ViewQuality` | `Enum.ViewQuality.Simple` | read/write | How the view is drawn. `Simple` draws without shadows or post-processing effects, which suits a monitor feed. `Full` draws the way the main view does. |
| `Resolution` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(512, 288)` | read/write | The size of the texture, in pixels. Each side is limited to `[render] max_view_resolution` (1024 by default); a larger size is scaled down with its aspect ratio kept. |
| `UpdateInterval` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The number of frames between pictures: at 1 the view is drawn every frame, and at 4 every fourth frame, for a quarter of the cost. |
| `ViewName` | `string` | — | read/write | The name of the texture: it is available as `view://` followed by this name. If two have the same name, the one created first draws and a message is logged for the other. The texture is black until the first picture is drawn. |
